title: The Trade
description: What a blacksmith's shop actually is, which is a pile of iron and a person who has
decided to be patient with it -- and, more to the point, every mechanism the
A branch that converges, an OR-gate, two quests that lock each other out, a job you
can do forever, an order that matters, a task you may skip, a quest that hides
until it is done, an alias, a slow check, and a number big enough to need the
progress bar. None of it is a special case in the engine: every one is a field on
a quest or a task, and every one is named in the file that uses it.
